messages.content: Hey, remind me to prep for an 8 PM family WeChat call tonight. Mom scheduled it to discuss the apartment hunting.
Done. I've set a reminder for 8 PM. Is she worried about how the search is going?
Yeah, Mom felt incredibly anxious about the high rent prices we encountered during the apartment hunting. It's been stressing her out.
Rents are definitely crazy right now. Any updates on actually locking a place down to ease her mind?
Well, because of a landlord delay, I promised Mom I will officially sign a lease by Sunday instead of Friday for the apartment hunting.
Got it, Sunday it is. A couple of extra days isn't too bad. Did you factor in all the extra moving costs?

Yes, Mom noted that the standard agency fee for the apartment hunting is exactly 2% of the annual rent. Oh, and she also decided that I must buy new curtains immediately after concluding the apartment hunting.
Sounds like she's already starting the interior decorating! I'll have all your notes ready for the call tonight.

To keep us grounded, I seriously committed to Liwei that we will strictly cap our budget increase at exactly 6000 RMB for the apartment hunting. Not a penny more.
That's a very smart boundary to set. Sticking to that 6000 RMB cap will definitely keep things manageable for you both. Is she looking forward to finally wrapping this up?
Definitely. In fact, Liwei decided we should celebrate with hot pot once the apartment hunting is over.
Hot pot sounds like the perfect reward! Let's hope tonight's viewing is the winner so you two can finally sign that lease by Sunday and celebrate.
Thanks! Keep your fingers crossed for us tonight.
Fingers crossed! Good luck to you and Liwei tonight. Have fun at the hot pot if you seal the deal!
